answer: Admission leaves a spiral of pairwise trials: each newcomer must complete a joint task with every already seated name, observed by an external witness who may serve only one pair per epoch. The tide of pending pairs cannot be skipped by staggered filings, because every earlier pair remains binding. A farm adding k clones to N seats therefore needs kN + k(k-1)/2 independent witness slots, while a nebula of unrelated applicants cannot be impersonated by one operator. Reused witnesses or rehearsed tasks slash the bonds and collapse the cluster.
